en-US.title: SnakeTastic
en-US.subtitle: Classic Snake Game, Ad Free
en-US.promoText: Go head to head with a friend on one phone, or take on King Cobra, the toughest CPU snake. Five arenas, six powerups, and 33 achievements to earn.
en-US.description:
Classic Snake for one phone: play solo, take on the CPU, or go head to head with a friend. No ads, no accounts, and no tracking.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Solo: eat, grow, and chase your high score
• Vs CPU: three snakes to beat, Garter, Rattler, and King Cobra
• 2 Player: two snakes on one board at the same time, face to face, each steering from their own end of the screen
• Swipe to turn

SHAPE THE BOARD
• Five arenas: Open, Pillars, Gauntlet, Portals, and Underpass
• Three speeds and three grid sizes
• Wrap Edges, so a snake that leaves one side comes back on the other
• Six optional powerups, from a speed boost to reversing your rival's controls

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Stats for every mode, with a ranking of your players
• 33 achievements, bronze to gold
• Player profiles, each with its own color

ALWAYS READY
• Retro sound effects and haptics
• Light and dark mode, on iPhone and iPad
• Plays offline

If you play other Tastic games, your player profiles come with you on the same device.

Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/jayrdeaton/Snake
